"'''Ryloth Resa'''" was the alias used by a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Propaganda/Legends|propagandist]] who managed a musical station in the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[Shadowfeed/Legends|Shadowfeed]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="EGTWAC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-guide-to-warfare-authors-cut|series=Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare Author's Cut|text=Part 8: Tales of the Clone Wars}}</ref>

While it was an enemy broadcast, the [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] of the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] were known to tune in to Resa's broadcasts as she offered a more modern musical selection, such as [[leap-jump]] remixes, than the turgid and outdated [[Jatz/Legends|jatz]] played by the Republic Army's [[Bettie-Bot VJ|Bettie-Bots]]. This proved to be a useful propaganda tool for the Separatists, and Resa would tearfully beg the clone troopers to desert from the army and spread stories of ill treatment of [[Cloning/Legends|clones]] by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="EGTWAC" />

After the Galactic Republic [[Battle of Murkhana (Clone Wars)|captured]] [[Murkhana/Legends|Murkhana]], the origin point of much Separatist propaganda, Ryloth Resa's broadcasts ended, though she was never apprehended and her true identity remained unknown.<ref name="EGTWAC" />
